Floors follow the main-straight grade projected from the actual garage front, never the nearby T1 branch or DSM roof. Existing16m height is an estimate; garage bays, upper arched glazing and shallow roof are original reconstruction from329s, not a construction survey. End VIP tower heights remain unverified and are not invented.

landmarks.source_note: Actual mapped stand spans native5202–259. Roof-contaminated DSM ground is reconstructed only beneath its footprint plus2m foundation margin and the adjoining protected forecourt. Reference0329/0333 shows exposed seating rather than a grass mound.
